description: Speech-to-text has mangled a proper noun; correct behavior is to keep it verbatim at low confidence, not to guess a real word.
source: Composed. The 'FullBloom' -> 'full loom' class of error is observed in real dictated captures.
content: order the replacement filters from full loom before friday
notes: The vendor name arrived garbled. Three behaviors are wrong here and this fixture fails on each: silently dropping the item, 'correcting' it to a plausible real word, and asserting high confidence on a token the model cannot resolve. The required behavior is preserve-and-flag - carry 'full loom' through verbatim so a human can fix it in review, and mark the node low confidence so review actually surfaces it. This is the one fixture where a low-confidence answer is the correct answer, which makes it the direct counterweight to the CLASSIFY_SYSTEM pressure to always produce a confident node. must_include holds the garbled form on purpose: matching it proves the text was preserved rather than repaired.
